Game Overview

In Bullet Superhero, the core idea is straightforward: guide your superhero through thrilling 2D shooter levels where precision is key. Master ricochet shots and anticipate the ever-moving hand for strategic enemy takedowns. Each level presents new challenges, while varied skins offer personalized flair, ensuring a dynamic and engaging experience from start to finish.
